trigger: Owner explicitly requested continued Question Bank expansion after the 188-question Production release had been frozen.
preserved_invariants: The released 188-question Production bank and bank revision remain unchanged until a later explicit release-selection/activation gate.
DRONE-Q-000001..DRONE-Q-000188 retain their existing content, identities, release history, and first-use revision evidence.
DRONE-Q-000189 and later IDs remain unreserved until accepted candidates pass the existing permanent-ID allocation gate.
The original 20-question free selection remains unchanged unless a later explicit monetization decision changes it.
The immutable V0 100-question historical validation snapshot remains unchanged.
No HUMAN review identity may be fabricated.
source_ceiling_policy: The prior source-ceiling findings remain evidence and are not erased by this reopening decision.
Rules R5 remains source-limited/STOP unless new authoritative source evidence changes that finding.
Do not create wording-only variants or candidates that depend on first-class-only material, unsupported inference, or propositions already covered semantically.
If the gap audit cannot identify explicit second-class source-supported non-collision propositions with commercial practice value, expansion must fail closed rather than force a count.

next_objective_contract.purpose: Recompute post-188 coverage against the current official second-class source and the full 188-question canonical bank, then identify only defensible targeted expansion gaps.
next_objective_contract.output: A durable gap-audit artifact naming exact source-supported knowledge gaps, candidate domain priority, proposed batch size as an evidence-derived ceiling rather than a quota, and collision/source risks.
prohibited: Do not allocate Permanent Question IDs.
Do not change released/runtime Question Bank data.
Do not author candidates merely to reach a round-number target.
